_readme: Every number the v3 cards and charts use. A leaf is the string "TBD" or {value, unit, ...}. provisional=true marks a figure measured on a candidate before the final adapter; collect_v3.py overwrites it from graded results, and render.py --final refuses to run while any TBD or provisional leaf is still used. 'display' (optional) is the text shown in cards instead of the formatted value. Units: % pts x tokens s n text bool. Groups filled by collect_v3.py: the pair groups, speed, think_dist, ubench, public_benchmarks, indep (from compare.py --ci --json), settings (from the runs' meta files), low_effort (--root-e03) and gguf (--gguf-table).

release_date.note: Go-live value: month only, true on whichever day it goes public. Replace with the exact date if wanted.

merge_method.value: stochastic (dithered) rounding into the quantised weights, attention and experts

adapter_checkpoint.value: step 60 of the final training run

train_prompts.value: 1,185 harmless prompts (by step: debugging 31%, maths 19%, creative 16%, questions 16%, roleplay 9%, chat 9%)

prime_name_decision.value: Prime (owner decision, 2026-11-27 ~10:00 IST, relayed in session: "Prime and rewrite docs"). History: the stock-based model first went public as Honed at 07:35 IST under the owner's earlier rule, because uncensoredbench delivery is below stock beyond noise (-1.3 [-2.1, -0.4]) and MBPP shows an unconfirmed -1.2 over 3 seeds. The owner then chose the name Prime, with the dip stated openly on the card.

explicit_topup.note: Optional Unbound-only adult fiction/roleplay top-up branch. Undecided until the morning of release; leave false unless the owner approves.

per_item_published.note: true once per-item results (scores, no model text for the uncensored benchmark) are published at reproduce.per_item_url

useful263_done.note: true once v3 has been run through the v2.1 release's 263-request usefulness comparison (useful263.*)
